text.KJV: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
text.ASV: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
text.WEB: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

text.KJV: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
text.ASV: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
text.WEB: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

text.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.ASV: Blessed `be' the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.WEB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

text.KJV: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
text.ASV: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
text.WEB: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

text.KJV: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
text.ASV: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
text.WEB: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

text.KJV: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
text.ASV: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,
text.WEB: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,

text.KJV: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: that the proof of your faith, `being' more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:
text.WEB: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

text.KJV: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
text.ASV: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
text.WEB: whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory—

text.KJV: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
text.ASV: receiving the end of your faith, `even' the salvation of `your' souls.
text.WEB: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

text.KJV: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
text.ASV: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that `should come' unto you:
text.WEB: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

text.KJV: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
text.ASV: searching what `time' or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.
text.WEB: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.

text.KJV: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
text.ASV: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angel desire to look into.
text.WEB: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

text.KJV: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
text.ASV: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
text.WEB: Therefore prepare your minds for action, be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

text.KJV: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
text.ASV: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in `the time of' your ignorance:
text.WEB: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

text.KJV: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
text.ASV: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;
text.WEB: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;

text.KJV: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
text.ASV: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.
text.WEB: because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”

text.KJV: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
text.ASV: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man's work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:
text.WEB: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:

text.KJV: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
text.ASV: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;
text.WEB: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

text.KJV: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
text.ASV: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without spot, `even the blood' of Christ:
text.WEB: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ;

text.KJV: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
text.ASV: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of times for your sake,
text.WEB: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

text.KJV: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
text.ASV: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
text.WEB: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

text.KJV: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
text.ASV: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
text.WEB: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:

text.KJV: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
text.ASV: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
text.WEB: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

text.KJV: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
text.ASV: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:
text.WEB: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

text.KJV: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
text.ASV: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.
text.WEB: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

text.KJV: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, all evil speakings,
text.ASV: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
text.WEB: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

text.KJV: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
text.ASV: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;
text.WEB: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,

text.KJV: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
text.ASV: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
text.WEB: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

text.KJV: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
text.ASV: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,
text.WEB: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

text.KJV: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
text.ASV: Because it is contained in scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
text.WEB: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

text.KJV: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
text.ASV: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;
text.WEB: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,”

text.KJV: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
text.ASV: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
text.WEB: and, “a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

text.KJV: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light;
text.ASV: But ye are a elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for `God's' own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
text.WEB: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

text.KJV: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
text.ASV: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
text.WEB: who in time past were no people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

text.KJV: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
text.ASV: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lust, which war against the soul;
text.WEB: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

text.KJV: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
text.ASV: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
text.WEB: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.

text.KJV: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
text.ASV: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
text.WEB: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

text.KJV: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
text.ASV: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.
text.WEB: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

text.KJV: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
text.ASV: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
text.WEB: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

text.KJV: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
text.ASV: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
text.WEB: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

text.KJV: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
text.ASV: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
text.WEB: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

text.KJV: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
text.ASV: Servants, `be' in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
text.WEB: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

text.KJV: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
text.ASV: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.
text.WEB: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

text.KJV: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
text.ASV: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted `for it', ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer `for it', ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
text.WEB: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

text.KJV: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
text.ASV: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:
text.WEB: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

text.KJV: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
text.ASV: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
text.WEB: who did not sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

text.KJV: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
text.ASV: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered threatened not; but committed `himself' to him that judgeth righteously:
text.WEB: Who, when he was cursed, didn’t curse back. When he suffered, didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

text.KJV: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
text.ASV: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.
text.WEB: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

text.KJV: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
text.ASV: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
text.WEB: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

text.KJV: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
text.ASV: In like manner, ye wives, `be' in subjection to your won husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;
text.WEB: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;

text.KJV: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
text.ASV: beholding your chaste behavior `coupled' with fear.
text.WEB: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

text.KJV: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
text.ASV: Whose `adorning' let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;
text.WEB: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

text.KJV: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
text.ASV: but `let it be' the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible `apparel' of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
text.WEB: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.

text.KJV: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
text.ASV: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
text.WEB: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

text.KJV: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
text.ASV: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
text.WEB: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

text.KJV: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
text.ASV: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with `your wives' according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.
text.WEB: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.

text.KJV: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
text.ASV: Finally, `be' ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:
text.WEB: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tender hearted, courteous,

text.KJV: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
text.ASV: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
text.WEB: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.

text.KJV: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
text.ASV: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:
text.WEB: For, “He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.

text.KJV: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
text.ASV: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
text.WEB: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

text.KJV: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
text.ASV: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.
text.WEB: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

text.KJV: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
text.ASV: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?
text.WEB: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?

text.KJV: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
text.ASV: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness' sake, blessed `are ye:' and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;
text.WEB: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

text.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
text.ASV: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: `being' ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
text.WEB: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:

text.KJV: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
text.ASV: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.
text.WEB: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

text.KJV: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
text.ASV: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.
text.WEB: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.

text.KJV: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
text.ASV: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
text.WEB: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

text.KJV: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
text.ASV: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,
text.WEB: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

text.KJV: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
text.ASV: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:
text.WEB: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

text.KJV: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, `even' baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;
text.WEB: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

text.KJV: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
text.ASV: who is one the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
text.WEB: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

text.KJV: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
text.ASV: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
text.WEB: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

text.KJV: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
text.ASV: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
text.WEB: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

text.KJV: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
text.ASV: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:
text.WEB: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

text.KJV: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
text.ASV: wherein they think strange that ye run not with `them' into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of `of':
text.WEB: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:

text.KJV: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
text.ASV: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.
text.WEB: who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

text.KJV: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
text.ASV: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
text.WEB: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

text.KJV: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
text.ASV: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:
text.WEB: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

text.KJV: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
text.ASV: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:
text.WEB: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

text.KJV: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
text.ASV: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:
text.WEB: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

text.KJV: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
text.ASV: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;
text.WEB: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

text.KJV: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
text.ASV: if any man speaketh, `speaking' as it were oracles of God; is any man ministereth, `ministering' as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
text.WEB: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

text.KJV: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
text.ASV: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:
text.WEB: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

text.KJV: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
text.ASV: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.
text.WEB: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

text.KJV: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
text.ASV: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed `are ye'; because the `Spirit' of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.
text.WEB: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

text.KJV: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
text.ASV: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men's matters:
text.WEB: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

text.KJV: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
text.ASV: but if `a man suffer' as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
text.WEB: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

text.KJV: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
text.ASV: For the time `is come' for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if `it begin' first at us, what `shall be' the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?
text.WEB: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

text.KJV: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
text.ASV: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?
text.WEB: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

text.KJV: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
text.ASV: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.
text.WEB: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

text.KJV: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
text.ASV: The elders among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
text.WEB: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.

text.KJV: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
text.ASV: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to `the will of' God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
text.WEB: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

text.KJV: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
text.ASV: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.
text.WEB: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

text.KJV: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
text.ASV: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.
text.WEB: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

text.KJV: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
text.ASV: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
text.WEB: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

text.KJV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
text.ASV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
text.WEB: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

text.KJV: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
text.ASV: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
text.WEB: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

text.KJV: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
text.ASV: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour,
text.WEB: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

text.KJV: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
text.ASV: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.
text.WEB: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

text.KJV: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
text.ASV: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
text.WEB: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

text.KJV: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
text.ASV: To him `be' the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
text.WEB: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

text.KJV: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
text.ASV: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account `him', I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand ye fast therein.
text.WEB: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

text.KJV: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
text.ASV: She that is in Babylon, elect together with `you', saluteth you; and `so doth' Mark my son.
text.WEB: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.

text.KJV: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
text.ASV: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
text.WEB: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
